access: NOIRLab Astro Data Lab SIA2 and cutout service, public, no credentials
purpose: A second independent optical reference. Every optical comparison so far has been Rubin against Legacy alone, which cannot say whether the field-dependent colour term, the crowding-dependent flux scale, and the residual sign imbalance belong to Rubin or to Legacy. Rubin-minus-DES answers that.
hscNote: HSC PDR2, the other survey named in this goal, publishes only HiPS tiles without credentials. Those are display products with no calibrated flux or variance plane and cannot support a photometric comparison, so no HSC science pixels are claimed here.
